answer: One wallet must not feed a thousand mouths: every claim pays a tide tax. Each claim posts its funding trail on the signal board; claims from one source share one tide, fees spiraling: five cents, ten, twenty, doubling. A warden checks each trail on the ledger in the hour; a shared source is a tide-pooled claim: void, taxed, barred a week. An honest worker pays five cents and one real job; 1,000 fakes owe past $50,000 and 1,000 trails to forge.
